note: Ground truth by construction: every `quote` below is embedded VERBATIM in the referenced document. Implicit requirements cite the supporting span(s) that appear verbatim, even though the requirement statement itself is inferred.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying leave type, start date, and end date.

source.quote: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying leave type, start date, and end date.

requirements.statement: The system shall route each submitted leave request to the employee's direct manager for approval.

source.quote: The system shall route each submitted leave request to the employee's direct manager for approval.

requirements.statement: An employee shall not be able to request more leave days than their available balance for the selected leave type.

source.quote: An employee may not request more leave days than their available balance for the selected leave type.

requirements.statement: The leave dashboard shall load quickly for all users.

source.quote: The leave dashboard should load quickly for all users.

requirements.statement: The system shall require multi-factor authentication for all manager and HR-admin logins.

source.quote: The system shall require multi-factor authentication for all manager and HR-admin logins.

requirements.statement: All employee and leave data shall be stored within the India (Asia-South) region.

source.quote: All employee and leave data shall be stored within the India (Asia-South) region.

requirements.statement: When a leave request is approved, the system shall deduct the leave days from the employee's balance, and only after final approval rather than on submission.

source.quote: When a leave request is approved, the system shall deduct the leave days from the employee's balance.
The deduction shall occur only after final approval, not on submission.

requirements.statement: Leave requests shall be submitted at least 3 working days before the start date, except for sick leave.

source.quote: Leave requests must be submitted at least 3 working days before the start date, except for sick leave.

requirements.statement: The system shall be usable on mobile browsers (Chrome and Safari) at 375px width.

source.quote: The system shall be accessible on mobile browsers (Chrome and Safari) at 375px width.

requirements.statement: The system shall email the employee when their leave request is approved or rejected.

source.quote: The system shall send an email notification to the employee when their leave request is approved or rejected.

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a separate leave balance per employee for each leave type.

source.quote: Each employee has a separate balance for casual, sick, and earned leave.

requirements.statement: Earned leave shall accrue at 1.5 days per completed month of service.

source.quote: Earned leave shall accrue at 1.5 days per completed month of service.

requirements.statement: The system shall retain an audit log of every leave approval and rejection for at least 7 years.

source.quote: The system shall retain an audit log of every leave approval and rejection for at least 7 years.

requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with the existing HRMS via its REST API for employee master data.

source.quote: The system shall integrate with the existing HRMS via its REST API for employee master data.

requirements.statement: The system shall let a manager approve or reject a request directly from the email notification.

source.quote: We need managers to be able to approve or reject requests directly from the email notification.

requirements.statement: One-day casual leave shall be auto-approved without a manager approval step.

source.quote: for casual leave of just one day, it should auto-approve without any manager step

requirements.statement: The approval flow shall be flexible enough to handle different departments.

source.quote: the approval flow needs to be flexible enough to handle different departments

requirements.statement: If the assigned manager is on leave, the request shall escalate to that manager's manager.

source.quote: if the manager is on leave themselves, it should go to their manager

requirements.statement: A new employee shall be able to apply for leave without training.

source.quote: a new joiner should be able to figure out how to apply for leave without any training

requirements.statement: The system assumes every employee already has a company SSO account.

source.quote: we're assuming everyone already has a company SSO account

requirements.statement: The system shall email the employee as soon as their leave is approved or rejected.

source.quote: please make sure employees get an email as soon as their leave is approved or rejected

requirements.statement: HR reports shall generate in under 10 seconds even for 5,000 employees.

source.quote: reports for HR must generate in under 10 seconds even for 5,000 employees

requirements.statement: HR shall be able to export the monthly attendance summary as an Excel file.

source.quote: HR should be able to export the monthly attendance summary as an Excel file

requirements.statement: Unused casual leave shall lapse at the end of the calendar year and shall not carry over.

source.quote: unused casual leave should lapse at the end of the calendar year and must not carry over

requirements.statement: The system shall let HR look up the approver and decision for any past leave request.

source.quote: we keep getting asked who approved a given leave last year and nobody can find out

requirements.statement: The system shall credit leave days back to the employee's balance when an approved leave is cancelled.

source.quote: The days should be credited back to my balance automatically.

requirements.statement: The system shall show the employee's leave balance on the home screen without further navigation.

source.quote: I want to see my leave balance on the home screen without clicking anything.

requirements.statement: The system shall provide managers a team attendance view, replacing the shared spreadsheet.

source.quote: On a shared spreadsheet that breaks all the time.

requirements.statement: The system shall support the regional languages Hindi and Marathi.

source.quote: It must work in the regional languages, at least Hindi and Marathi.

requirements.statement: The system shall let an employee attach a medical certificate (PDF) to a sick-leave request.

source.quote: Allow employees to attach a medical certificate (PDF) to sick-leave requests.

requirements.statement: The system shall let an employee raise a leave request with a leave type and dates.

source.quote: As an employee I want to raise a leave request with a leave type and start/end dates.

requirements.statement: An employee shall only be able to see their own leave data, not that of colleagues.

source.quote: Employees must only see their own leave data, not their colleagues' data.

requirements.statement: The system shall comply with the company's data-retention policy DRP-2024.

source.quote: Must comply with the company data-retention policy DRP-2024.

requirements.statement: The system shall send managers a weekly digest of pending approvals.

source.quote: The old system emailed a weekly pending-approvals digest to managers every Monday at 9 AM.

requirements.statement: The system shall support half-day leave, counted as 0.5 days.

source.quote: Half-day leave is supported and counted as 0.5 days.

requirements.statement: The system assumes public holidays are maintained in the separate calendar module, which will continue to be used.

source.quote: Public holidays are maintained in a separate calendar module that we will keep using.

requirements.statement: The system shall run on the corporate network only and shall not be exposed to the public internet.

source.quote: The system runs on the corporate network only.
There is no plan to expose it to the public internet.

requirements.statement: Employees shall be allowed to carry over up to 5 unused casual leave days.

source.quote: employees have always been allowed to carry over up to 5 unused casual leave days

requirements.statement: The system shall apply leave notice periods and count leave days using a working-day calendar that excludes weekends and public holidays.

source.quote: Leave requests must be submitted at least 3 working days before the start date, except for sick leave.

requirements.statement: The system shall support exactly three leave types: casual, sick, and earned.

source.quote: Leave types were casual, sick, and earned; there was never a bereavement category.

requirements.statement: The system shall perform a nightly backup of its data.

source.quote: It is a single-region on-prem install with a nightly backup.
